extDescription.message: Press one key to send the manga on your screen to Yomitoki on your own computer. Only what you can see is captured, and nothing leaves your computer except the recognized text.

commandCapture.message: Capture the visible page and translate it

statusDownHint.message: Run yomitoki serve in a terminal. This panel reconnects on its own.

modeSaveHint.message: When the episode is captured, press “Translate episode” in Yomitoki. Translating a whole episode at once keeps the context consistent.

modeSaveNeedsSeries.message: “Save only” needs a series and an episode.

captureNeedsShortcut.message: Chrome only allows capturing when you press the shortcut or click the toolbar icon. Press $KEY$, or click the Yomitoki toolbar icon first.

noText.message: No text was found on this page.

emptyText.message: Open the manga in your browser, make sure a whole page is on screen, then press the shortcut.

errServerDown.message: Can't reach Yomitoki. Make sure yomitoki serve is running.

errClaudeLogin.message: Claude Code isn't signed in, or the sign-in expired. Run claude in a terminal to sign in, then try again.

errClaudeMissing.message: Claude Code isn't installed on this computer. Translation needs it.

errCapture.message: This tab can't be captured. Chrome doesn't allow capturing chrome:// pages or the Web Store.

errInterrupted.message: The last translation was interrupted (Chrome paused the extension's background worker). Press the shortcut again.

errTimeout.message: No response after 5 minutes. Make sure Yomitoki is still running, then press the shortcut again.

smallCapture.message: This capture is only $W$ × $H$, so the text may be too small to read reliably. Make the browser window bigger (or close the side panel for a moment) and capture again.

privacy.message: Only what's visible on screen is captured. Images on the page are never downloaded or read.
